VeilPass • Phase 1 demo
Prove eligibility without disclosing the underlying academic record.

Two shared demo credentials. One fixed policy.
This walkthrough uses a real, disposable local Midnight network.

The credential is encrypted in this browser with a passphrase.
Student ID, subject, degree, and exact year remain private inputs.

Policy: approved university and graduation year ≥ 2020.
The public authorization contains a scoped nullifier, not the credential.

A funded development wallet connects through the Midnight connector adapter.
It auto-approves local transactions; this is not an installed wallet extension.

Real proof generation, wallet balancing, submission, and confirmation.
No simulated proof result. The local prover receives private witness data.

Authorization confirmed on the local Midnight chain.
The receipt shows the actual transaction and block, not a public Preprod deployment.

Now select the ineligible graduate sample.
Authenticity alone is insufficient: the private year must satisfy the policy.

The circuit rejects the ineligible credential. No success receipt is issued.
Replay protection is also checked in the integration test.

Demo limits: shared bearer credentials, small anonymity set, and a trusted local prover.
Production identity, revocation, recovery, and independent audit are future work.
